CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No.1767.

SHANGHAI, 19th May 1936.

〔右上角印章及手写内容模糊，仅可辨：... REGIST ... D. ...〕

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter of December
17, 1935, No.D.7136, and to inform you that John Waan Sik-
hung alias John S.A.Waan, alias Wen Hsi-huang, alias Waan
Yoh Mong, alias Oen Sek-ang (溫錫煌) was banished
from Hongkong for a period of 10 years and departed on
the 21st of April 1936 by train for Sham Chun, Kwangtung,
a border station on the British Chinese frontier.

He speaks English and Malay, understands the Nether-
lands language and speaks also the Cantonese dialect..

As far as is known he travels on a Chinese passport,
it is possible however that he is in the unlawful possession
of Netherlands or Netherlands Indian papers.

He was born in Singapore, is 34 years of age, height 166,
heavy built.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

〔左侧手写批注：Noted / Who 20/5 Noted / 16 5 / 12〕
T.Robertson,Esquire,
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

他出生于新加坡，现年34岁，身高166厘米，体格魁梧。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.150.
Strictly Confidential.

SHANGHAI, 11th January 1936.

Sir,

With reference to your letter of December 17, 1935, No.D.7136,
I have the honour to inform you that it has been proved that John
S.A.Waan is the same person as Oon Seck-ang, mentioned for the
last time in your letter of May 17, 1933, No.D.4793, who in 1928
was suspected of fraud in respect of a sweepstake lottery and was
consequently expelled from the Chinan University. In 1930 he was
arrested in Hongkong, charged with forgery and sentenced to 8
months imprisonment. On his discharge from prison he secured
employment as Chinese Secretary in the Italian Consulate at Hong-
kong, continuing there until July 1935 when his services were
dispensed with. Since then the Italian Consul has had complaints
against him for withholding a telegram, addressed to the Con-
sulate, for using official Consulate paper and for making ma-
licious calls on the telephone.

Oon is also responsible for a malicious article published
in the Chinese Weekly Review of 7 January 1933, and purported
to be written by a Netherlands subject of Chinese origin at
Shanghai, Oey Kang-lim alias Huang Chiang-lin, against whom he
had a grievance and concerning whose family he published de-
famatory notices.

He also laid false information concerning forged bank notes
against a Java Chinese Merchant Au Pit-seng, to whom and his
family he also sent indecent pictures through the post.

Since

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch),
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

Attach file
7/2
page_data.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第150号。
绝密。

上海，1936年1月11日。

先生：

关于您1935年12月17日第D.7136号来函，谨此通知您，业已证实John S.A. Waan与Oon Seck-ang为同一人，此人最后一次出现在您1933年5月17日第D.4793号来函中，曾于1928年因涉嫌在一种抽彩给奖法（sweepstake lottery）中进行欺诈而被震旦大学开除。1930年，他在香港被捕，被控伪造罪，判处监禁8个月。出狱后，他在香港意大利领事馆谋得华务秘书一职，一直工作到1935年7月被解雇。此后，意大利领事对他提出投诉，指控他扣留一封寄给领事馆的电报、使用领事馆官方信纸以及进行恶意电话骚扰。

Oon还对1933年1月7日《字林西报周刊》（Chinese Weekly Review）上发表的一篇恶意文章负责，该文章假称由一位居住在上海的荷籍华人Oey Kang-lim（又名Huang Chiang-lin）所写，他对后者怀恨在心，并发布了有关其家族的诽谤性告示。

他还向一位爪哇华商Au Pit-seng提供了关于伪造钞票的虚假指控，并通过邮政向此人及其家人发送淫秽图片。

自

T.P. Givens 先生，
副总监（特别处），
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

附件
7/2

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Since his dismissal from the Italian Consulate he seems to
depend on the Java Fruit Agency in which he has been interested
for some time. He resides with his wife at No. 72, Sun Keen
Terrace, 1st floor.

He claims to have been born in Singapore and to have been
taken to Batavia when an infant. His father apparently died in
Swatow 15 years ago. His mother is said to be living in Batavia
while he claims to have four brothers WAAN SIK TAO, WAAN SIK TSHI,
WAAN SIK HIOEN, WAAN SIK HONG, who are all thought to be living
in the Netherlands Indies.

After being expelled from Chinan in 1928, he made one trip as
a clerk on one of the European steamers, sailing from Hongkong and
then secured employment as outdoor agent in the Advertising and
Publicity Bureau, Hongkong.

His various aliases appear to be :
John Waan Sik-hung, John S.A. Waan, Wen Hsi-huang, Waan
Yoh-mong, Oen Sek-ang, Oen Seck-aang, Oon Seck-ang
(溫 錫 煌).

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

自从被意大利领事馆解雇后，他似乎依靠他关注了一段时间的爪哇水果代理行（Java Fruit Agency）为生。他与妻子居住在孙科台路（Sun Keen Terrace）72号二楼。

他声称出生于新加坡，婴儿时期被带到巴达维亚。他的父亲显然于15年前在汕头去世。据说他的母亲住在巴达维亚，而他声称有四个兄弟：WAAN SIK TAO、WAAN SIK TSHI、WAAN SIK HIOEN、WAAN SIK HONG，据信他们都居住在荷属东印度群岛。

1928年被震旦大学开除后，他曾作为职员在一艘欧洲轮船上工作过一次，从香港起航，随后在香港广告与宣传局（Advertising and Publicity Bureau）谋得外勤代理一职。

他的各种别名似乎是：
John Waan Sik-hung, John S.A. Waan, Wen Hsi-huang, Waan Yoh-mong, Oen Sek-ang, Oen Seck-aang, Oon Seck-ang (溫 錫 煌)。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，
〔签名〕
华务秘书。

December 17 35.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 3362 of December 5, 1935, and to
inform you that careful inquiries have failed to
confirm the report that Geor. e J.T. Waan arrived in
Shanghai by the s.s. "Tjisadane" or any other vessel.
The s.s. "Tjisadane" arrived here from Hongkong on
December 1, 1935, but George Waan's name did not
appear on the passenger list. Enquiries at the Customs
House and among local fruit importers show that no
shipment of Java mangoes has arrived recently in
Shanghai from Hongkong.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General.

December 17 35.

My dear Barton,

With reference to your letter of December 6,
1935, I have to inform you that careful inquiries
have failed to confirm the report that George S.T. Waan
arrived in Shanghai by the s.s. "Tjisadane" or any
other vessel. The s.s. "Tjisadane" arrived here from
Hongkong on December 1, 1935, but George Waan's name
did not appear on the passenger list. Enquiries at the
Customs House and among local fruit importers show that
no shipment of Java mangoes has arrived recently in
Shanghai from Hongkong.

Yours sincerely,

James Barton, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 2, Special Br. xxxx
REPORT

File No.
No. S. A. 19.
Date December 14, 1935

Subject Inquiry from Netherlands Consulate-General re. Mr. George
S. T. Waan.

Made by D. S. Jones Forwarded by D B Jones A..

With reference to the attached inquiry re. Mr. George
S. T. Waan, director of the Java Fruit Agency and manager
of the Java Products Agency, of Java and Singapore, I have
to state that although careful enquiries have been made it
has been impossible to obtain any information regarding
this individual. The name does not figure on the passenger
list of the s.s. "Tjisadane", which arrived in Shanghai
from Hongkong on December 1, 1935, and it has proved
impossible to verify that he arrived in Shanghai by this
or any other vessel.

A visit to the Customs House elicited the information
that during the last week or so no cases of mangoes have
been imported into Shanghai from Hongkong. Enquiries have
also been made at fruit importers in an effort to trace
Mr. Waan through his shipment of Java mangoes; these have
likewise led to no result.

D. S. Jones
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

File
JAS.

关于所附关于Java Fruit Agency董事兼Java Products Agency经理（位于爪哇和新加坡）George S. T. Waan先生的查询，我必须说明，尽管进行了仔细查询，但无法获得关于此人的任何信息。该名字未出现在1935年12月1日从香港抵达上海的“Tjisadane”号轮船的乘客名单上，且无法核实他是否通过该船或其他船只抵达上海。

SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST.
Thursday, November 28, 1935.

JAVA FRUIT SHIP
Manager arrives to push sales in North China
------------------
Mangoes for Exhibition

Among the passengers arrived here yesterday by
the K.C.J.L. line Tjisadane from Batavia was Mr. George
B. T. Maan, director of the Java Fruit Agency, and manager
of the Java Products Agency, of Java and Singapore. Mr.
Maan is the brother of Mr. John S. H. Maan, the former Chinese
secretary to the Italian Consulate General here. He brought
with him 164 cases of fresh Java mangoes for local fruit
exhibitions. The mangoes include four different varieties.
Mr. Maan who was the Chief Editor of the daily
Chinese Malay paper Sin-po of Batavia, will continue on the same
ship which sails this morning for Amoy and Shanghai, to push
the sale of Java fruits in North China.

爪哇水果船
经理抵沪以推动华北销售
---
参展芒果

昨日乘坐K.C.J.L.航线“Tjisadane”号从巴达维亚抵达此处的乘客中，有Java Fruit Agency董事兼Java Products Agency（位于爪哇和新加坡）经理George B. T. Maan先生。Maan先生是此前任此地意大利总领事馆华务秘书的John S. H. Maan先生的兄弟。他带来了164箱新鲜爪哇芒果用于本地水果展览。这些芒果包括四个不同品种。Maan先生曾是巴达维亚每日中文马来文报纸《新报》（Sin-po）的主编，将继续乘坐今早驶往厦门和上海的同一艘轮船，以推动爪哇水果在华北的销售。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3862.

SHANGHAI, 4th December 1935.

Sir,

I have the honour to enclose herewith a news item from
the South China Morning Post of 26 November 1935 concerning
the brothers George J.P. Taen and John S.H. Taen.

From correspondence received from the Netherlands Consu-
late General at Hongkong it would appear that John, who has
many aliases, was born at Singapore but educated in Java.
After his dismissal from the service of the Italian Consulate
General at Hongkong he appears to have written many articles
in the papers and letters to the authorities often of a slan-
derous nature. Latterly he is reported to have engaged in
blackmail.

The local agents of the Java China Japan Line could not
confirm whether George Taen arrived by the "Tjisadane" in
Shanghai.

As he appears to pose sometimes as a representative of the
Department of Agriculture at Batavia I should be much obliged
and activities
to be informed of his movements/should they come to your notice.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

T.P. Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch),
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

S2. For comment please.
If anything known about
them locally.
J.H.
6 DEC. 1935

D.S. Givens.
D.S.R. 7/12.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第 3862 号。

上海，1935年12月4日。

先生：

谨此随函附上1935年11月26日《南华早报》上关于George J.P. Taen和John S.H. Taen兄弟的一则新闻剪报。

从荷兰驻香港总领事馆收到的往来信件来看，John拥有许多别名，出生于新加坡，但在爪哇接受教育。在被香港意大利总领事馆解雇后，他似乎在报纸上发表了许多文章，并向当局撰写了许多信件，往往具有诽谤性质。据报道，他最近从事敲诈勒索活动。

爪哇中国日本轮船公司（Java China Japan Line）的本地代理无法确认George Taen是否乘坐“Tjisadane”号抵达上海。

鉴于他有时冒充巴达维亚农业部代表，如蒙告知其行踪/若引起贵方注意，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，

华务秘书。

T.P. Givens 先生，
副总监（特别处），
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

S2. 请予评论。
如果 locally 知道关于
他们的任何情况。
J.H.
1935年12月6日

D.S. Givens.
D.S.R. 12/7.

against him for withholding a telegram, addressed to the Con-

Shanghai, Ooy Keng-lim alias Huang Chiang-lin, against whom he 


had a grievance and concerning whose family he published de- 
7 famatory notices, 

He also laid false information concerning forged bank notes 
against a Java Chinese Merchant Au Pit-seng, to whom and his 
family he also sent indecent pictures through the post.
